title: Slushie Bar Xtra Pineapple Ice 10ml Nic Salt E-Liquid
description: Slushie Bar Xtra Pineapple Ice brings together the sharp, tangy sweetness of ripe Pineapple with a refreshingly cool icy breeze for a vape that is as bold as it is refreshing. Each puff delivers the bright, tropical sweetness of Pineapple, perfectly balanced by a cooling exhale that makes this e-liquid ideal for those who enjoy fruity flavours with a frosty twist. Crafted with a 50VG/50PG ratio, Slushie Bar Xtra Nic Salts are designed for use with Mouth-to-Lung (MTL) vape kits and pod systems. Each e-liquid in the collection provides smooth throat hits and rapid nicotine relief, making them ideal for those seeking a satisfying alternative to traditional tobacco. Available in 10mg and 20mg nicotine strengths, these e-liquids are perfect for all-day vaping with a flavour-packed experience waiting in every puff.
